ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $5.00 no-show fee to the rider; log the voided no-show on the driver's record for repeated invalid no-show claims.
ruling.reasoning:
Safety screen: the complaint, the driver statement and the chat contain no threat, harassment, sexual remark or dangerous-driving allegation — nothing safety-related. Proceeding on the merits.

Cancellation type: the driver cancelled and the recorded reason is rider_no_show, so NS-1/NS-2 govern (NS-0).

NS-1 conditions, checked against the system records:
(i) Arrival at pickup: driver_arrived at 21:32:45; the GPS cluster from 21:33:00 to 21:37:35 sits at ~1.35258, 103.94434, i.e. roughly 40–50 m from the pickup point (1.3525, 103.9447) — within 200 m. Met.
(ii) Free wait: the 5-minute window runs from the later of scheduled pickup (21:32:45 if the driver arrival is treated as the scheduled pickup) and arrival, so it expires at 21:37:45. The driver cancelled at 21:37:35 — 10 seconds early. No no-show threshold (e.g. 8 min) appears in this record. Not met.
(iii) Contact attempts: ≥ 1 in-app message (21:33:15, 21:37:25) was sent — met; but the required ≥ 1 in-app phone call must be a completed call. The only call record, 21:34:15, shows answered=false, duration_s=0.0 — an unanswered, zero-second call is not a phone call made to the rider. Not met.
(iv) Continuous presence: the telemetry shows the driver stationary at the pickup for the whole window (samples at 21:33–21:37 all at the same location) with no GPS gap. Met.

Two NS-1 conditions therefore fail, so the fee is voided under NS-2: refund_full of $5.00. The rider's account is clean, but the profile never decides the case — the GPS, call and event records do. The driver marked/cancelled on a no-show without completing the required call and before the free wait expired; there is no indication of fraudulent arrival marking (GPS was at the pickup), so no RD-6/NS-2 flag_account is applied; the void should nonetheless be logged against the driver's no-show record.

element_findings.element: NS-1(i) driver arrived and GPS within 200 m of pickup
element_findings.reason: Arrival recorded and GPS stationary ~40–50 m from Tampines Mall pickup (1.3525, 103.9447), within the 200 m radius.

element_findings.element: NS-1(ii) 5-minute free wait elapsed before cancellation
element_findings.reason: The wait ran from the later of arrival/scheduled pickup (21:32:45) and would expire at 21:37:45; cancellation at 21:37:35 is 10 seconds early. No record override threshold applies.

element_findings.element: NS-1(iii) at least 1 in-app message AND at least 1 in-app call before cancelling
element_findings.reason: Messages were sent, but the sole call was unanswered with 0 s duration — not a phone call to the rider as NS-1 requires.

element_findings.element: NS-1(iv) driver remained at the pickup point throughout
element_findings.reason: Every telemetry sample in the wait window is at the same pickup location with no gap.

rejected_claims.reason: Driver states he waited more than 5 minutes and cancelled for no-show, but the event/GPS records show cancellation at 21:37:35, before the 5-minute window from 21:32:45 expired, and the only call was unanswered (0 s). System records override the statement.
